# Shape Valley

> Shape Valley (Shape Valley: Tiny Drivers) is a calm, low-stimulation driving game for kids aged 6–8 on iPhone and iPad. It has four gentle modes (Calm Drive, Taxi, Tidy Dozer and Lawnmower), no ads, no tracking in the app, no accounts, and works offline. It is out now on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/shape-valley-tiny-drivers/id6824337876

Shape Valley was made by Zach (Zachary Lau), a dad whose son got overwhelmed by busy, fast-paced kids' games. He built a calmer driving game for him; his son's schoolmates played it too, and other parents asked for a public version.

Key facts:
- Platform: iOS and iPadOS (iPhone and iPad)
- Age range: 6–8 (App Store kids age band)
- Modes: Calm Drive (free driving through soft hills), Taxi (pick up and drop off passengers), Tidy Dozer (push balls and toys into a hole), Lawnmower (mow stripes until the garden is done)
- Design: soft colours, slow motion, quiet sounds; no timers, scores, streaks or "game over"
- Privacy: no ads, no tracking or analytics in the app, no accounts (the website’s /launch/ pages use a Google Ads conversion tag); works offline (only buying or restoring a subscription needs a connection)
- Parent Zone: play-time limit, driving speed and time of day, behind a grown-up gate
- Pricing: free Basic plan; Family plan with a 7-day free trial, then US$29.99/year
- Status: live on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/shape-valley-tiny-drivers/id6824337876)
- Contact: zachlaudev@gmail.com

- [About Zach](https://shapevalleygame.com/about/): the founder story behind Shape Valley
- [Blog](https://shapevalleygame.com/blog/): parent guides on calm, low-stimulation play
- [What are low-stimulation games?](https://shapevalleygame.com/blog/low-stimulation-games-for-kids/): a parent's guide with screen-time guidance from the WHO and AAP
- [Calm games for kids](https://shapevalleygame.com/blog/calm-games-for-kids/): an honest dad's shortlist of calm apps and offline ideas
- [Car games for kids on iPad, compared](https://shapevalleygame.com/blog/car-games-for-kids-ipad/): a fair comparison of Fiete Cars, Labo Brick Car 2, Sago Mini Trips+, Hot Wheels Unlimited and Shape Valley (price, ads, in-app purchases, platforms, pace)
- [How to end screen time without a meltdown](https://shapevalleygame.com/blog/end-screen-time-without-meltdown/): a research-backed guide for parents of 6–8 year olds (natural stopping points, timers, real-toy play, calmer game design)
- [Support](https://shapevalleygame.com/support/): help and contact
- [Privacy Policy](https://shapevalleygame.com/privacy/): what data is (not) collected
